classification.difficultyReason: Decompose nested fractions, manage reversed-factor signs and combine common denominators with reciprocal multiplication; these are extended routine procedures without an essential unsignposted insight.

answer.worked:
Simplify the first operand using a common denominator.

$$\begin{align*}2-\frac{3n}{m}+\frac{9n^2-2m^2}{m^2+2mn}&=\frac{2m(m+2n)-3n(m+2n)+9n^2-2m^2}{m(m+2n)}\\2-\frac{3n}{m}+\frac{9n^2-2m^2}{m^2+2mn}&=\frac{mn+3n^2}{m(m+2n)}\\2-\frac{3n}{m}+\frac{9n^2-2m^2}{m^2+2mn}&=\frac{n(m+3n)}{m(m+2n)}\end{align*}$$

Clear the fraction in the nested denominator.

$$\begin{align*}m-2n-\frac{4n^2}{m+n}&=\frac{(m-2n)(m+n)-4n^2}{m+n}\\m-2n-\frac{4n^2}{m+n}&=\frac{m^2-mn-6n^2}{m+n}\\m-2n-\frac{4n^2}{m+n}&=\frac{(m-3n)(m+2n)}{m+n}\end{align*}$$

Then simplify the divisor.

$$\begin{align*}\frac1m-\frac{1}{m-2n-\frac{4n^2}{m+n}}&=\frac1m-\frac{m+n}{(m-3n)(m+2n)}\\\frac1m-\frac{1}{m-2n-\frac{4n^2}{m+n}}&=\frac{(m-3n)(m+2n)-m(m+n)}{m(m-3n)(m+2n)}\\\frac1m-\frac{1}{m-2n-\frac{4n^2}{m+n}}&=\frac{-2n(m+3n)}{m(m-3n)(m+2n)}\end{align*}$$

Multiply by the reciprocal and cancel common factors.

$$\begin{align*}\left(2-\frac{3n}{m}+\frac{9n^2-2m^2}{m^2+2mn}\right)\div\left(\frac1m-\frac{1}{m-2n-\frac{4n^2}{m+n}}\right)&=\frac{n(m+3n)}{m(m+2n)}\times\frac{m(m-3n)(m+2n)}{-2n(m+3n)}\\\left(2-\frac{3n}{m}+\frac{9n^2-2m^2}{m^2+2mn}\right)\div\left(\frac1m-\frac{1}{m-2n-\frac{4n^2}{m+n}}\right)&=\frac{3n-m}{2}\end{align*}$$

Clear the fractions in each compound fraction and factorise.

$$\begin{align*}\frac{1}{x+\frac{1}{x+2}}&=\frac{x+2}{x(x+2)+1}\\\frac{1}{x+\frac{1}{x+2}}&=\frac{x+2}{(x+1)^2}\\\frac{1}{x+\frac{1}{x-2}}&=\frac{x-2}{x(x-2)+1}\\\frac{1}{x+\frac{1}{x-2}}&=\frac{x-2}{(x-1)^2}\end{align*}$$

$$\begin{align*}\frac{x-\frac4x}{x^2-2+\frac{1}{x^2}}&=\frac{x^3-4x}{x^4-2x^2+1}\\\frac{x-\frac4x}{x^2-2+\frac{1}{x^2}}&=\frac{x(x-2)(x+2)}{(x-1)^2(x+1)^2}\end{align*}$$

Multiply by the reciprocal of the divisor.

$$\begin{align*}\frac{1}{x+\frac{1}{x+2}}\times\frac{1}{x+\frac{1}{x-2}}\div\frac{x-\frac4x}{x^2-2+\frac{1}{x^2}}&=\frac{x+2}{(x+1)^2}\times\frac{x-2}{(x-1)^2}\times\frac{(x-1)^2(x+1)^2}{x(x-2)(x+2)}\\\frac{1}{x+\frac{1}{x+2}}\times\frac{1}{x+\frac{1}{x-2}}\div\frac{x-\frac4x}{x^2-2+\frac{1}{x^2}}&=\frac1x\end{align*}$$
